grouping_principle: A planned operation or procedure is a Reason for Encounter even when no symptom is present; the interview prepares a clinician handoff without granting clearance or prescribing perioperative management.

constraints: Do not infer fitness for surgery or anaesthesia clearance.
Do not decide whether surgery should proceed, calculate a risk score, order a test, or start, stop or bridge a medicine.
Do not incorporate ESC guideline content without the formal licence required by its official page.
Keep generated content unreviewed and research_only until clinical review and Korean local-protocol alignment.
